Subject: Term reshape & capacity handshake — QBR scheduling

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for the catch-up last week. As discussed, we'd like to kick off a short renewal + expansion handshake to align on timeline, capacity targets, and the QBR slot where we’ll present pricing/term options. Goal: land a term amendment that covers the uplift and gives you predictable throughput heading into peak season.

Proposed 30–45m QBR slots (please pick any that work, or send an alternative):
- Thu Aug 4 — 10:00 AM PT
- Fri Aug 5 — 2:00 PM PT
- Tue Aug 9 — 11:00 AM PT

Suggested agenda (30m):
1) Current usage & target uplift (ops)
2) Capacity model options (reserved vs burst) + cost delta (sales)
3) Security/legal gating + next steps (1–2 action items)

Attachments: proposed-term-options.pdf (pricing bands + term amendment draft). I’ve looped in Ben (renewals) and Marissa (CS) to cover capacity and onboarding logistics.

Would you also confirm the uplift target you’re planning for (tokens/day or peak concurrent)? That will drive the sizing note Ben will share.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a slot.

—

Kimberly —

Thanks — Aug 5 at 2:00 PM PT works for our team. A couple of items from our side prior to the QBR:
1) Uplift target: we’re planning to move from approximately 2M tokens/day to ~5M tokens/day over the next quarter (peak needs in September).
2) Security: please have someone on the Redwood security/compliance side available — we have a short SOC 2 and data retention checklist to run through. Procurement is on copy for the term/pricing path.
3) Draft SOW: can you share a short SOW that outlines the uplift milestones and responsibilities?

One more request — can Ben include a simple CSV with current usage and the proposed capacity snapshot so our infra lead can review before the QBR?

Appreciate it — see you Aug 5 2pm PT.

Best,
Asha Raj
Head of Operations | StellarScape
asha@stellarscape.com

Subject: Re: Term reshape & capacity handshake — QBR scheduling

Asha / Kimberly —

Thanks for the uplift target, Asha — that helps a lot. To give a quick read:

- Current: ~2M tokens/day steady with spikes up to 3–3.5M on promo days.
- Target: 5M tokens/day steady; plan for 7–8M/day peak headroom (Sept timeframe).

Options we’ll bring to the QBR (high-level):
1) Reserved block (monthly commit) — best unit economics for steady uplift. Shows lowest per-token price once committed.
2) Reserved + burst credits — keep a smaller commit and attach burst credits for occasional peaks (lower monthly commitment, predictable peak protection).
3) On-demand optimized (quantized variants) — lower cost per-token at slight quality tradeoff for non-critical workloads.

Operational notes: we can stage the uplift with a 30–45 day ramp and a soft cutover window to validate KV caching and batching settings (typically avoids cold-cache latency). If you want, we can aim for Sep 1 as an uplift go-live and use August for testing and runbook handoff.

Attachments I’m sending: stellarscape_capacity_snapshot.csv (current usage by day + peak windows) and SLA_draft_v2.pdf (SLA language + uptime/latency SLOs).

Action items for QBR:
- Confirm commit level or preferred reserved + burst mix (you)
- Confirm uplift go-live target (suggest Sep 1)
- Security sync: add a 20m slot with our security lead to run the SOC2 checklist prior to signature (Hannah is available week of Jul 31 / Aug 2).

If that looks reasonable I’ll include the capacity CSV in the calendar invite and prep two pricing bands for Aug 5.

—
Ben Carter
Renewal Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachment: stellarscape_capacity_snapshot.csv (CSV, 1 file)
Attachment: SLA_draft_v2.pdf (PDF, 4 pages)

Asha — great, we’re confirmed for Fri Aug 5, 2:00 PM PT. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=stellarscape-qbr (we’ll send formal invite after this message).

Quick next steps from our side before the QBR (Aug 5):
- Ben: finalize two pricing bands (reserved commit vs reserved+burst) and include the capacity_snapshot.csv in the invite.
- Security: Hannah will run a 20m pre-QBR SOC2 checklist session with your security lead — Hannah, can you propose two windows (Jul 31 morning PT or Aug 2 afternoon PT)?
- Legal/Procurement: we’ll prepare a term amendment (DocuSign link below) for review post-QBR; please loop in procurement for any contract gating items.

DocuSign (term amendment draft): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-SS
Calendar poll (if you want to re-check times): https://bit.ly/stellarscape-qbr

Asha — please reply if Aug 5 still works and confirm the Sep 1 uplift target. If Procurement wants a redline ahead of the QBR we can provide the term amendment as a working draft.

Thanks all — looking forward to the discussion.
